note: Open Doors: what a credit score can open, and what opens the next door. A guide built from the customer's own Westpac data, never an approval. Only Westpac's own products are linked, worded as 'explore', with no rates quoted.
disclaimer: A guide, not an approval. Lenders decide, and they also look at your income, expenses and full credit report.
bands_source: Equifax, What is a credit score?
status_rule: Open when every check passes. Opening when at least half pass. Otherwise Not yet.
